Name: Magic Rock Candy Recipe
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]Currently compatible with 1.6 Update[/size]



[line]
[size=5]Features[/size]

This mod adds a recipe for magic rock candy. It is a cooking recipe, so you will need a kitchen or cookout kit to make it. The cooking ingredients are listed below:

[spoiler]
Recipe:
1 Prismatic Shard
1 Sugar
1 Wood [/spoiler][s]

[/s]There are 2 versions of this mod:

1. Mining- The recipe unlocks when you reach Mining level 10.

2. Desert Trader- The recipe can be purchased for 25 iridium bars any day of the week. The price is steep in an attempt to keep the item balanced.


[size=5]Update Log[/size]

Version 1.3.0- Mod is now compatible with the 1.6 update (tested in game version 1.6.15). There is still a version for Mining level 10 and trading from the Desert Trader for 25 iridium bars. Shop tile framework is no longer needed.

Version 1.2.0- SUCCESS!!! I have added a new version that allows you to purchase the recipe from the Desert Trader for 25 Iridium bars. [s]This version requires Shop Tile Framework to use.[/s]

Version 1.1.0- I removed the "available immediately" version as it did not actually unlock the recipe. I am working on a version that does this properly.
